title: The First Pass: A Complete Worked Example Through the Generative-Collapse Spine
object_of_study: a single measurement passed through the full validation spine
main_question: Can one simple declared measurement be traced reproducibly through every stage of the contract-first validation spine?

claim_layers.claim: The paper traces three identical voltage readings through the twelve stops of the GCD/UMCP validation spine and derives a three-valued verdict; appendices show a single near-zero channel destroys IC while F stays apparently healthy (Zenodo record description).
All numbers are stated to be reproducible from the open-source reference implementation.
The library reads this as the canonical pedagogical entrance whose diagnostic content is the heterogeneity gap.
